input.summary: Ported fir.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fir.dp.cpp. The port has no dpct headers, helpers or macros. It uses a 1-D nd_range, a local_accessor tile, group_barrier, and the 64 taps captured by value in the kernel in place of constant memory. Error handling uses SYCL exceptions. It compiles with add_dpct_include=false and no warnings. I did not run the output against the reference, so the -96 dBFS null test is unchecked. The kernel arithmetic and summation order match the CUDA original, so it should match.
